description: Election Commission - The Media Guidelines made by the Election Commission under Article 104B(5)(a) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka - Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1955/19 of 2016.02.25 is hereby rescinded.
reasoning: This gazette contains Media Guidelines issued by the Election Commission under Article 104B(5)(a) of the Constitution, specifically addressing media conduct during election periods. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes, including regulations for media coverage of elections, impartial reporting requirements, treatment of candidates and political parties, and procedures during polling. This directly fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral commission decisions and guidelines governing election-related media conduct.
